resources.string: No network. The INTERNET permission is absent from the manifest, so this app cannot send a notification anywhere, to anyone, ever.

1. Grant notification access below.
2. Grant the battery-optimisation exemption, or Android will eventually stop waking the listener.
3. Tap to pay. Watch the count go up.
4. Export to a file before you uninstall anything — app storage is destroyed on uninstall.
Everything means everything: WhatsApp, SMS, email previews. Use it only long enough to find the Wallet package name, then switch back and purge.
Allowlist — one package name per line
